column1: Beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster's palm; 50' effective range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will ''turn off''; when the fist is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the spell duration has not expired).
column2: Lights a 10'R area about the point touched; if the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/being. See Section 7.1.7.
column3: Creates a bright aura about the target, making him appear more powerful and subtracting 10 from all attacks against the target.
column4: As Light I, except 1 or 2 areas can be created with a total radius of 20' (e.g., one area of 20' or two areas of 10').
column5: Causes a 10'R burst of intense light, all within are stunned for 1 round per 10 failure.
column6: As Aura, except it makes him appear very powerful; subtracting 15 from all attacks against the target.
column7: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot form the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Shock Bolt Attack Table.
column8: As Light II, up to 3 areas can be created with a total radius of 30'.
column9: As Light I, except it is the equivalent of full daylight; it also nullifies all magically created darkness for the duration.
column10: As Light I, except caster can delay the spell up to 24 hours; it can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster): elapsed time, specific movements, specific sounds, or touch.
column11: A 6" radius ball of light is shot from the palm of the caster. It will travel to the limit of the range, explode (as a flare), burn with a bright light (as a flare), drift slowly to earth, and go out. An area equal to the range is lit if the flare can raise to its full range. If used against a target, use the Shock Bolt Attack Table but deliver Heat criticals.
column12: As Light III, except up to 5 areas can be created with a total radius of 50'.
column13: As Light III, except up to 10 areas can be created with a total radius of 100'.
column14: As Utterlight I, except up to 5 areas can be created with a total radius of 50'.
column15: As Light III, except total radius is 10' per level.
column16: As Aura, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.
column17: Caster can cause a lightning bolt to strike a target within his range. Results are determined on the Lightning Bolt Attack Table. There must be a storm within 1 mile that is severe enough to cause precipitation or lightning or very heavy winds. The caster must be outdoors to cast this spell.
column18: As Aura, except target seems like a minor god and the subtraction is 25.
column19: As Utterlight I, except as many areas as the caster levels can be created with a total radius of 10' per level.
